unverified: Romanised titles are kept as the pages spell them where no page gives the Devanagari; Devanagari is used only where a Nepali Wikipedia page prints it (सालको पातको टपरी हुनी, सितल दिने पिपल समी छ, रुमाल हल्लाई हल्लाई, बोल माया, गल्बन्दि, ख्याल ख्यालमै दिल बस्यो कान्छी सालीमा, तानसेन खस्यौली). The lead may want Devanagari for the rest; none was invented.
Year conflict: 'Rumal Hallai Hallai' is 2021 on English Wikipedia (Kulendra Bishwakarma songs table) but 2024-09-24 on iTunes; the playlist uses 2021.

iTunes dates are digital release dates and may be later than first issue: 'Simsime Panima' track rows say 1996-04-29 on a 2023 Music Nepal reissue; Indreni Cassette Centre releases (2008-2011) may be reissues of older cassettes.
Prem Raja Mahat & Rekha Shah 'Simsime Panima': tied to dohori only by Mahat's page category 'Dohori singers' (and its Dohori link); no page calls the song itself dohori.

Badri Pangeni 'ख्याल ख्यालमै दिल बस्यो कान्छी सालीमा': Nepali Wikipedia names it his best-known song (album 'सुसुरालीमा') but gives no year; the next sentence credits a song with Sindhu Malla on the album 'ससुराली', so the duet partner is likely Sindhu Malla but is not stated for this title. Year null, partner left off.
Bom Bahadur Karki & Prem Raja Mahat 'Paanko Paat' (Music Nepal, 1988-07-14 on iTunes): exists, but a group song tied to dohori only by Mahat's category. Left out.
Pashupati Sharma 'Lutna Sake Lut' (2019 on Wikipedia, 2022 on iTunes): a solo satirical song, genre 'Satire' on Wikipedia; not a duet. Left out.
Prem Raja Mahat & Bam Bahadur Karki 'Khola Pari Nirmaya' (1986, Music Nepal's first folk song): named on Wikipedia, no record page read and no dohori tie for the song. Left out.
Field recordings of village or rodhi ghar dohori: none found on a page a script can read (CREM-CNRS search did not filter; no MusicBrainz release; Smithsonian not tried). Left out.
Anna Stirr's study (Free Library copy) refused scripts ('Just a moment'); the Himal Southasian article is paywalled after its opening paragraphs. Neither used beyond the readable text.
Ram Thapa's albums 'Sero Phero Salaam Chha Mero' and 'Arya Bhanjyang' are listed as dohori on Wikipedia with no year or track list; kept as albums only.
Near years: Hira Devi Waiba 'Chura ta Hoina Astura' and Narayan Gopal 'Euta Manchhe Ko' have no year on the pages read; stored null.

MusicBrainz: one search returned 'server busy' and the second found only one Nepali dohori release (Janaki Panth, 'Babal Dami (Teej Dohori)', 2014, f21bc10d-6cf3-44e4-a1cb-c3857950ef13); not used, as its MusicBrainz record was not read.

More than 100 single-track releases from 2023-2026 that name Tamang selo in the title (Raj Kumar Dong Tamang, Chitra Bahadur Tamang, Jivan Bomjan Tamang, Susmita Syangtan, Zidan Waiba Tamang, uploads credited to 'Tamang selo song'): seen in the iTunes search; only three were used, as the rest are hard to tell apart and some look like channel re-uploads.

MusicBrainz: only three 'Tamang Selo' recordings (Kutumba x2, Dhaneswar Tiwari/Sobit Rana/Durga Gurung on 'Saurav (Music for Relaxation)'); the first query got a 503 busy reply and was retried once. Not used, as iTunes covered the same tracks.
Ekantipur, 'Damphu Selo's Century Journey' book (6 Nov 2026): only the summary is in the page text; the article body loads by script, so the book's history of the genre could not be read.
